# go-modern-slices-clone

**Since:** Go 1.21

## Summary

Use slices.Clone to copy a slice.

## Details

slices.Clone returns a shallow copy of a slice using the standard helper.
It is clearer than append-copy boilerplate and preserves nil slices.

## Examples

### Before

```go
copied := append([]T(nil), values...)
```

### After

```go
copied := slices.Clone(values)
```
